summary: Host Stats tab restyled: hardware sections, gauges and charts are white cards on a neutral canvas with plain headings, muted labels, tabular values and a thin fill bar per gauge, replacing the accent-coloured left borders, tinted backgrounds, half-circle arcs, uppercase captions and pill badges. Warm and critical readings keep their word beside the value. Collapsed hardware cards show their row count. API impact: none.

guide.reason: docs/guide/usage-history.md describes the gauges, hardware sections and charts by their readings and the Warm and Critical marks, all of which are unchanged; only decoration changed.

api.reason: Presentation only; no request or response changed.

verification.method: npm --prefix web run typecheck; web/src/stats.test.mjs (helpers and the series-on-white 3:1 contrast check); Playwright Chromium against a real Controller with the simulated agent, hardware and 10-minute history answered by route interception with fictional values, labelled simulated: hardware summary, System, Disks and Temperature sensors cards with counts, four gauge tiles (one Warm, amber bar) and the charts rendered with no page errors; captures inspected.
